source: OSRS Wiki: the pages "Free-to-play/Pay-to-play <Skill> training" (checked 2026-10-03) and the "Training plan" tables of this guide. The speed (xph) is a wiki guideline and depends on your level, inventory and axe/pickaxe; it is not part of the time calculations: time is computed only from the player's own measurements. XP per action (xpa) are exact in-game values.

methods.name: Regular trees
methods.where: Anywhere ordinary trees grow (for example by Lumbridge Castle)

methods.name: Oak trees
methods.where: By the Draynor bank, west of the Varrock bank, Port Sarim, Rimmington

methods.name: Willow trees
methods.where: Port Sarim: willow trees east of the Rusty Anchor Inn
methods.note: Bank useful logs or drop unwanted ones. With your levels and axe known, the app picks the willow spot and says whether the bank walk pays. Rates depend on your axe, level and competition.

methods.name: Yew trees
methods.where: South of the Edgeville bank: two yew trees close to the bank
methods.note: Slower XP than willows; the guide uses yews for the money the logs fetch. Other free yews stand behind Varrock Palace and south of the Falador east bank.

methods.name: Oak trees at Seers' Village or Hosidius
methods.where: Seers' Village, Hosidius
methods.note: The wiki's best up to level 35 with membership; willows work too.

methods.name: Teak trees
methods.where: Ape Atoll, Fossil Island, Isle of Souls, Prifddinas
methods.note: Normal chopping; the personalized model uses your level and usable axe. It does not assume tick manipulation. The supported Isle of Souls spot drops logs because its banking route is not modelled.

methods.name: Shrimp and anchovies with a net
methods.where: Al Kharid, Draynor Village, the swamp by Lumbridge
methods.note: You can drop the fish (Shift + click) and not go to the bank.

methods.name: Sardines and herring for bait
methods.where: The same places as with a net

methods.name: Trout and salmon with fly fishing
methods.where: Barbarian Village, the river by Lumbridge
methods.note: Trout gives 50 XP, salmon 70. You need a lot of feathers (Feather): about 600 for levels 20-40.

methods.name: Lobsters in pots
methods.where: Musa Point on Karamja (the passage is 30 coins)

methods.name: Tuna and swordfish with a harpoon
methods.where: Musa Point on Karamja

methods.name: Monkfish
methods.where: Piscatoris Fishing Colony
methods.manualSetup: Reference method: verify Swan Song access and set up the Piscatoris catch/bank cycle manually. Its complete gathering route and personalized rate are not modelled yet.

methods.name: Karambwan
methods.where: Near the DKP fairy ring
methods.manualSetup: Reference method: verify Tai Bwo Wannai Trio fishing access, vessel bait and an accessible banking route manually. Its complete catch/bait/bank cycle is not modelled yet.

methods.name: Copper and tin
methods.where: The swamp south-east of Lumbridge, the Dwarven Mine
methods.note: Mine copper or tin until Mining 15. Keep ore you need for Smithing; drop only unwanted ore. A usable pickaxe can stay in your bag.

methods.name: Iron, dropping the ore
methods.where: Al Kharid mine: stand between the three iron rocks and mine them in turn without moving.
methods.note: Drop the ore: the rate is the dropping rate, with no bank trips. Al Kharid has three iron rocks next to each other. Use a pickaxe your Mining level allows; it can stay in your bag. The app avoids a mine whose monsters would attack you (the scorpions of Al Kharid mine attack combat level 28 or lower). About 50,000 XP/h from 41 with a rune pickaxe and three rocks in reach; lower tiers mine slower (OSRS Wiki, checked 2026-11-02).

methods.name: Motherlode Mine
methods.where: Motherlode Mine (Falador)
methods.manualSetup: Reference method: set up the pay-dirt, hopper, sack and bank cycle manually. The complete processing route, yield and personalized rate are not modelled yet.
methods.note: The Wiki gives a rate only at level 90 with top gear (about 52,000–62,000 XP/h). Golden nuggets from the sack buy the prospector kit (+2.5% Mining XP) (OSRS Wiki, checked 2026-11-02).

methods.name: Granite in the Desert Quarry
methods.where: Desert Quarry, south of the Shantay Pass
methods.note: The fastest members Mining: about 87,000 XP/h at 45 rising to 126,000 at 99 with 3-tick mining; at most about 63,000 without tick manipulation. Bring waterskins against the desert heat (OSRS Wiki, checked 2026-11-02).
methods.manualSetup: Reference method: waterskins and 3-tick mining are set up manually; the rate is not modelled yet.

methods.name: The gnome course or the Draynor rooftops
methods.where: Tree Gnome Stronghold; Draynor Village
methods.note: There are no falls on the gnome course and no food is needed.

methods.name: The Al Kharid rooftops
methods.where: Al Kharid
methods.note: Falls are possible; Marks of Grace drop.

methods.name: Brimhaven Agility Arena
methods.where: Karamja (Brimhaven)

methods.name: The Canifis rooftops
methods.where: Canifis
methods.note: Low XP, but the most Marks of Grace for the level: the course for the Graceful set.

methods.name: The Falador rooftops
methods.where: Falador
methods.note: Marks of Grace drop; falls are possible.

methods.name: The Seers' Village rooftops
methods.where: Seers' Village
methods.note: Faster with Camelot Teleport set to the course (the hard Kandarin diary).

methods.name: The Pollnivneach rooftops
methods.where: Pollnivneach
methods.note: The hard Desert diary raises the pace.

methods.name: The Rellekka rooftops
methods.where: Rellekka
methods.note: The hard Fremennik diary raises the pace.

methods.name: The Ardougne rooftops
methods.where: East Ardougne
methods.note: Marks of Grace pile up on one tile and do not vanish while you run.

methods.name: Low-level cooking
methods.where: The range or fire nearest a bank that this account can use
methods.note: Use an owned usable catch or raw meat; current preparation is one executable batch, not the whole goal. The existing fire needs no logs or tinderbox. Burnt food gives no XP; buying refills needs confirmed coins.

methods.name: Trout, pike or salmon
methods.where: The range or fire nearest a bank that this account can use
methods.note: Use owned fish your Cooking level allows; current preparation is one executable batch. Recheck supplies after each batch; burnt fish gives no XP. Buying refills needs confirmed coins.

methods.name: Tuna, lobster or swordfish
methods.where: The range or fire nearest a bank that this account can use; withdraw usable raw fish first
methods.note: Use owned fish your Cooking level allows; current preparation is one executable batch, not a whole-goal quantity. Burnt fish gives no XP. Buying refills needs confirmed coins.

methods.name: Wine (a jug with grapes)
methods.where: At the Grand Exchange bank: buy the grapes and jugs of water there; no range or guild access is needed
methods.note: Combine 13 grapes with 13 jugs of water per starter bag. Withdraw owned ingredients first. Wait 12 seconds after the batch for fermentation and XP. Below Cooking 68, bad wine gives no XP; recheck your level and budget before another batch.

methods.name: Anchovy pizza
methods.where: At the Grand Exchange bank: buy plain pizzas and anchovies and add the anchovies to the pizzas there; no fire or range
methods.note: Adding anchovies to a plain pizza never burns. It can end in profit when anchovy pizzas sell for more than the two parts; the shared model compares current prices.

methods.name: The quest The Knight's Sword
methods.where: Falador (route step S2-07)

methods.name: Bronze axes, scimitars and warhammers
methods.where: The anvil by the west Varrock bank
methods.note: Bronze axes (1 bar, 12.5 XP) to 5, scimitars (2 bars, 25 XP) to 9, warhammers (3 bars, 37.5 XP) to 18; then bronze platebodies.

methods.name: Bronze platebodies
methods.where: The anvil by the west Varrock bank

methods.name: Iron anvil items
methods.where: The anvil by the west Varrock bank
methods.note: The shared recipe model selects usable daggers, warhammers or platebodies, including affordable partial bar stacks. Bring a hammer; temporary boosts are not assumed.

methods.note: The shared recipe model selects usable daggers, warhammers or platebodies, including affordable partial bar stacks. Bring a hammer; temporary boosts are not assumed.

methods.name: Leather armour (gloves to chaps)
methods.where: At the Grand Exchange bank: buy the leather, needle and thread there and craft by the bank

methods.name: Hardleather bodies
methods.where: At the Grand Exchange bank: buy the hard leather, needle and thread there and craft by the bank
methods.note: The best F2P armour crafting: about 91,000 XP/h with banked hard leather, needle and thread (OSRS Wiki, checked 2026-11-02).

methods.name: Gold and gem jewellery
methods.where: The Edgeville or Al Kharid furnace
methods.note: Gold rings from 5, necklaces from 6, unstrung amulets from 8, then sapphire (20), emerald (27), ruby (34) and diamond (43) rings, necklaces and amulets. Moulds cost 5 gp at Dommik in Al Kharid or Rommik in Rimmington. The shared model compares owned materials and current prices; profit is not guaranteed.

methods.name: Cutting gems (sapphires from 20, emeralds from 27, rubies from 34)
methods.where: By a bank

methods.name: Cutting diamonds
methods.where: By a bank
methods.note: Diamond cutting unlocks at 43. Compare current input cost, sale value and the available budget; a slower affordable method may be more practical.

methods.name: Strike spells on cows and chickens
methods.where: The farms by Lumbridge
methods.note: Use the spell named by the plan and select its autocast setting if your staff supports it; otherwise cast manually. A confirmed owned elemental staff must be equipped to replace its rune type. Higher Strikes are selected only when at least 20 casts are already supplied; otherwise Wind Strike is the budget fallback. Refill a low rune supply with a starter batch of 100 casts. Follow the recommended equipment: accuracy, lost defence, food and banking all affect the practical result. Verify that damage and Magic XP are arriving. Bring the food the plan lists, eat before health is low and bank when supplies run out. This is not a whole-goal budget, guaranteed profit or measured fastest method; confirmed completed sales alone fund purchases.

methods.name: Splash: spells on weak monsters
methods.where: Goblins/other harmless monsters
methods.note: Manual alternative only until the worn Magic attack bonus and location are verified. Bring runes for the chosen spell; monitor actual XP and do not assume zero damage from ordinary combat equipment.
methods.manualSetup: Verify Magic attack -64 or lower and a location outside the Lumbridge no-XP area.

methods.name: Enchant amulets
methods.where: At the Grand Exchange bank: buy strung amulets, cosmic runes and the elemental runes, and cast by the bank
methods.note: Lvl-1 Enchant (7) makes sapphire amulets into amulets of magic, Lvl-2 (27) emerald into defence, Lvl-3 (49) ruby into strength, Lvl-4 (57) diamond into power. Use strung amulets, not (u). The shared model compares the amulet, rune and product prices; the margin moves with the market.

methods.name: Low Level Alchemy
methods.where: Anywhere
methods.manualSetup: Choose expendable target items and verify all rune costs and actual coin margin first.

methods.name: Superheat Item (iron ore)
methods.where: At the Grand Exchange bank: buy the ore and runes there and cast by the bank
methods.note: Starter batch: 25 unnoted iron ore, 25 nature runes and 100 fire runes, or equip an owned Staff of fire instead of the fire runes. Bank surplus items to leave 25 ore slots plus rune stacks. Keep coal in the bank to make iron bars. Cast manually on each ore, then bank the bars and refill. This is one starter bag, not the full-goal cost; rate and profit are not guaranteed.

methods.name: High Level Alchemy
methods.where: At the Grand Exchange bank: buy the items and nature runes, wear a staff of fire, and cast by the bank
methods.note: Alch items with a high buy limit (gem necklaces, 18,000 per four hours) whose alch value beats the item and the nature rune. The shared model compares current prices; plate armour has a limit of 125 and is only an occasional bonus.

methods.name: The quest The Restless Ghost
methods.where: Lumbridge

methods.name: Burying bones from combat
methods.where: Wherever you fight (bones from giant frogs, giants)
methods.note: Bury drops while training combat. The rate depends on the monsters and time spent fighting; the dedicated bank-burying rate does not apply to collecting your own bones.
methods.manualSetup: Collect bones during an actual combat activity first. This passive supplement has no standalone training destination or fixed collection rate.

methods.name: Camdozaal: fish offerings
methods.where: Ruins of Camdozaal
methods.note: Enter the ruins below Ice Mountain after Below Ice Mountain. Catch fish with the net, prepare them at the table with the knife, then offer prepared fish at the mysterious altar (Prayer 1). Guppies need Fishing/Cooking 7, cavefish 20, tetras 33: use only fish both skills allow. Preparation can fail; raw fish cannot be offered. This manual guide has no measured or fully modelled catch-to-offering rate.

methods.name: Air runes
methods.where: The Air Altar south of Falador
methods.note: Take unnoted rune essence or pure essence. Use the talisman on the mysterious ruins, or wear the corresponding tiara to enter. Craft at the altar, leave through the portal, then bank and refill. The walking estimate excludes teleports and essence pouches.

methods.name: Earth runes
methods.where: The Earth Altar north-east of Varrock
methods.note: Take unnoted rune essence or pure essence. Use the talisman on the mysterious ruins, or wear the corresponding tiara to enter. Craft at the altar, leave through the portal, then bank and refill. The walking estimate excludes teleports and essence pouches.

methods.name: Guardians of the Rift
methods.where: The Temple of the Eye, through the portal in the Wizards' Tower basement
methods.note: Mine guardian fragments, craft essence, make runes at the altars the guardian opens and power the Great Guardian. The minigame also gives Crafting and Mining XP, runes and rewards such as the Raiments of the Eye and the colossal pouch. XP per hour is the wiki guide's rate for levels 40-50; it gives none below 40, where the real rate is lower.

methods.name: Lava runes
methods.where: The Fire Altar west of Emir's Arena
methods.note: Use an earth talisman on the Fire Altar with pure essence and at least as many earth runes; a binding necklace makes every rune a lava rune. XP per hour is the wiki guide's level-23 rate without essence pouches or the Raiments of the Eye; pouches raise it later (55,700 at 50, 64,800 at 75). It costs about 1 gp per XP or breaks even.

methods.note: Fight the storm spirit with other players and do not cook the harpoonfish, which gives the most Fishing XP. XP per hour is the wiki guide's rate at level 35 with a regular harpoon; the reward pool gives loot and the angler's outfit.

methods.name: Wintertodt
methods.where: The Wintertodt camp in the far north of Great Kourend
methods.note: Chop bruma roots and burn them in a brazier; fix it with the hammer and relight it with the tinderbox. The cold hurts, so bring food and warm clothing. XP per hour is the wiki guide's rate at level 50 on a fast world without fletching the roots; the reward crates give loot and the Pyromancer outfit, and chopping gives some Woodcutting XP.

methods.name: Giants' Foundry (bronze/iron swords)
methods.where: The Giants' Foundry
methods.note: Take Kovac's commission, set the moulds, melt bronze and iron bars 1:1 in the crucible and work the sword at the right heat. XP per hour is the wiki guide's rate with the best moulds, which assumes level 81; with fewer moulds it is lower. It makes about 141,000 coins an hour with bought bars.

methods.name: Giants' Foundry (iron/steel swords)
methods.where: The Giants' Foundry
methods.note: Take Kovac's commission, set the moulds, melt iron and steel bars 1:1 in the crucible and work the sword at the right heat. XP per hour is the wiki guide's rate with the best moulds, which assumes level 81; with fewer moulds it is lower. It makes about 134,000 coins an hour with bought bars.

methods.name: Giants' Foundry (steel/mithril swords)
methods.where: The Giants' Foundry
methods.note: Take Kovac's commission, set the moulds, melt steel and mithril bars 1:1 in the crucible and work the sword at the right heat. XP per hour is the wiki guide's rate with the best moulds, which assumes level 81; with fewer moulds it is lower. It makes about 80,000 coins an hour with bought bars.

methods.name: Giants' Foundry (mithril/adamantite swords)
methods.where: The Giants' Foundry
methods.note: Take Kovac's commission, set the moulds, melt mithril and adamantite bars 1:1 in the crucible and work the sword at the right heat. XP per hour is the wiki guide's rate with the best moulds, which assumes level 81; with fewer moulds it is lower. It costs about 37,000 coins an hour with bought bars.

methods.name: Enchant crossbow bolts
methods.where: At the Grand Exchange bank: buy gem-tipped bolts and runes, and cast Enchant Crossbow Bolt on the stack
methods.note: Each cast enchants 10 bolts: opal (4), sapphire (7), pearl (24), emerald (27), topaz (29), ruby (49), diamond (57), dragonstone (68), onyx (87). The shared model prices the bolts, the runes or a matching staff, and the enchanted bolts at the exchange; it casts automatically every 3 ticks, and fast manual casting is about 2.75 times quicker. It costs money at most prices.

methods.name: Seagulls at Port Sarim
methods.where: Port Sarim docks: select the level 3 Seagulls
methods.note: Level 3 Seagulls cannot damage you; check the target level. Equip a compatible bow and arrow stack. Use Accurate while starting, then Rapid after Ranged 5. Pick up reusable arrows when safe; bank before ammunition runs out. The 100 arrows are a starter stack; the card above counts the whole goal.

methods.name: The monks of Edgeville Monastery
methods.where: Edgeville Monastery
methods.note: Talk to a non-combat monk for free healing; leave combat before doing so. Equip the listed compatible bow and arrows; use Rapid after Ranged 5. Avoid Longrange if preserving Defence. Refill ammunition when low.

methods.name: Level 10 barbarians
methods.where: Barbarian Village: level 10 barbarians; check the level before attacking.
methods.note: An XP-focused bridge from Ranged 21 to 26. Choose level 10 barbarians, not the tougher level 15/17 variants. Bring the listed food and collect arrows safely. Monks remain the cheaper free-healing alternative. The guide point is the village centre; no zero-damage safespot is assumed.

methods.name: Wizards at the Wizards' Tower (manual alternative)
methods.where: Wizards' Tower: level 9 wizards.
methods.note: The Wiki lists wizards as an XP/loot alternative. Review your magic defence and food before choosing them. Starter supplies are not a safety guarantee.
methods.manualSetup: Incoming magic damage and rune-drop income are not estimated for this method; review the linked guide and your food before choosing it.

methods.name: Giant frogs
methods.where: Lumbridge Swamp
methods.note: Equip the compatible bow and arrows and use Rapid; avoid Longrange if preserving Defence. Bank while food or ammunition is low; do not wait until none remains.

methods.name: Flesh Crawlers
methods.where: Stronghold of Security, second level: Flesh Crawlers
methods.note: Requires Defence 40 in this recommendation. Check your ranged armour and food before entering; do not assume a ten-minute unattended window is safe. Bank when food or ammunition is low. No verified method tile is available, so follow the written location rather than an old arrow.

methods.name: Brutus from a safespot
methods.where: Brutus's pen in the cow field east of Lumbridge
methods.note: The best F2P Ranged XP: about 45,000–50,000 XP/h at Ranged 63 with adamant arrows (OSRS Wiki, checked 2026-11-02). Rotate between the safespots of the Brutus strategy page and bring enough arrows to stay there; he hits up to 19 if he reaches you. Ringing the cowbell amulet shortens his respawn.

methods.name: Plain pizza
methods.where: The range nearest a bank that this account can use (a pizza cannot be cooked on a fire)
methods.note: Buy pizza bases, tomatoes and cheese at the Grand Exchange. Add a tomato and then cheese to each base, then cook the uncooked pizzas on a range: 143 Cooking XP each, and the plain pizzas usually sell for more than the three parts. Pizzas burn less as your level rises (the wiki's range chart); burnt ones give no XP.

methods.name: Flesh Crawlers
methods.where: Stronghold of Security, second level: Flesh Crawlers
methods.note: The wiki's free-to-play melee guide lists the level 28 Flesh Crawlers on the second floor of the Stronghold of Security: they attack first, so you fight without walking between kills. Requires Defence 40 in this recommendation, because several of them hit you at once. Bring food and bank in Edgeville.

methods.name: Ogress Warriors from a safespot
methods.where: Corsair Cove Dungeon: Ogress Warriors from a safespot
methods.note: The wiki's free-to-play money maker for Ranged: rune armour and weapons, law and nature runes and uncut gems drop (Money making guide, about 50 kills an hour at 60 Ranged with iron arrows). Needs The Corsair Curse finished for the Corsair Cove bank. Stand on a safespot so they cannot hit you, pick up the rune drops, and alch them with High Alchemy at 55 Magic to stay longer.

methods.name: Moss giants from a safespot
methods.where: Varrock Sewers, the far end (or the south side of Crandor): Moss giants from a safespot
methods.note: The wiki's best free Ranged XP after Brutus. A knife or slash weapon cuts the web in the sewers; stand where they cannot reach you and pick up your arrows between kills. Big bones on every kill. Bank when food or ammunition is low.

methods.name: Chickens and cows
methods.where: The farms around Lumbridge
methods.note: Bones and hides drop along the way.

methods.name: The monks of Edgeville Monastery
methods.where: Edgeville Monastery
methods.note: Level 5 monks; talk to a non-combat monk for free healing, so no food is needed. They drop only bones.

methods.name: Al Kharid warriors
methods.where: The Al Kharid palace: level 9 warriors
methods.note: When you attack one, the others nearby join in: pull one aside first. The Al Kharid bank is just west of the palace.

methods.name: Barbarians
methods.where: Barbarian Village: the barbarians (mostly level 10)
methods.note: None attack first. Bank in Edgeville, north along the road.

methods.name: Brutus
methods.where: Brutus's pen in the cow field east of Lumbridge
methods.note: Double combat XP. Step aside when he winds up a charge or a stomp: they hit up to 19. He comes back about 22 seconds after each kill.

methods.name: Minotaurs
methods.where: Stronghold of Security, floor 1 (the Vault of War): the level 12 Minotaurs
methods.note: The entrance is in the Barbarian Village mine; there is no bank on the floor, so bank in Edgeville first.

methods.name: Giant frogs
methods.where: Lumbridge Swamp: level 13 Giant frogs
methods.note: Every kill drops Big bones: sell them or bury them for Prayer. They hit at most 2, so food is optional; an axe and a tinderbox let you cook on the spot. The swamp can be crowded.

methods.name: Hill Giants
methods.where: Edgeville Dungeon: Hill Giants
methods.note: Big bones on every kill, plus limpwurt roots and runes. Bring food that heals well; a Brass key saves the walk past the skeletons. Very crowded at busy hours.

methods.name: Moss giants
methods.where: Varrock Sewers (or Crandor): Moss giants
methods.note: Big bones, runes and items to alch. Bring a slash weapon for the webs in the sewers and food: they hit hard on low Defence, and the bank is far.

methods.name: Lesser demons
methods.where: Karamja Volcano dungeon (or Crandor): Lesser demons
methods.note: They hit up to 8; bring swordfish or better. Fire runes and vile ashes drop.

methods.name: Gemstone Crab (Tlati Rainforest)
methods.where: Tlati Rainforest
methods.note: No food is needed: the crab has "endless" health. The Wiki keeps it as the low-intensity method all the way to 99.

methods.name: Gemstone Crab with a bow (Tlati Rainforest)
methods.where: Tlati Rainforest
methods.note: The Wiki's idle Ranged method: the crab has endless health and no defence and burrows every 10 minutes. XP follows your own damage; darts are similar, and a yew or magic shortbow with rune arrows matches adamant darts.

methods.name: Sulphur Naguas (Neypotzli)
methods.where: Neypotzli, under Cam Torum
methods.note: Perilous Moons (with 48 Slayer) opens Neypotzli. A double-hitting weapon beats their negative armour: about 75,000 XP an hour at 60 Strength and up to 130,000 at 75 with the Blood Moon set and Piety. Moonlight potions are made inside; the noted ore and rune drops are a bonus not counted here.

methods.name: Maniacal monkeys with Hallowfell
methods.where: Kruk's Dungeon on Ape Atoll
methods.note: Monkey Madness II opens Kruk's Dungeon. Use Protect from Melee and stack the monkeys; their prayer potion drops keep the prayers up. The Wiki expects 200,000 XP an hour or more, and 300,000 with top Strength gear.

methods.name: Chinning maniacal monkeys
methods.where: Kruk's Dungeon on Ape Atoll
methods.note: Throw grey chinchompas at stacked maniacal monkeys, about 1,866 an hour. The Wiki's ideal rate is 290,000 XP an hour at 45 and 470,000 at 65, 10-15% less without perfect stacking. It is the fastest Ranged XP and costs far more than it earns.

methods.name: Ice Burst on maniacal monkeys
methods.where: Kruk's Dungeon on Ape Atoll
methods.note: Ancient Magicks come from Desert Treasure I. Autocast Ice Burst on stacked monkeys with a water staff: about 1,085 casts an hour, each 4 chaos and 2 death runes. The Wiki expects 250,000 XP an hour idle and 310,000 active.

methods.name: Pickpocketing men and women
methods.note: The rate is derived from the Wiki: 8 XP a pickpocket, success 180/256 at level 1 rising slowly, and 2 + 8(1 - p) ticks an attempt with the stun; walking and healing are not counted.
methods.where: Lumbridge, Draynor, Varrock

methods.name: The baker's stall (East Ardougne)
methods.where: The East Ardougne market

methods.name: Fruit stalls in Hosidius
methods.where: Hosidius, Great Kourend: the house by the beach with two stalls side by side
methods.note: Drop the fruit as you go; strange fruit restores run energy.

methods.name: Blackjack in Pollnivneach
methods.where: Pollnivneach

methods.name: Pickpocketing Ardougne knights
methods.where: The East Ardougne market
methods.note: Wear a Dodgy necklace and bring food; the medium Ardougne diary adds 10% success. Open the coin pouches before they fill.

methods.name: Arrow shafts
methods.where: By a bank

methods.name: Shortbows
methods.where: By a bank

methods.name: Oak and willow bows
methods.where: By a bank

methods.name: Maple bows
methods.where: By a bank
methods.note: Cut maple logs into unstrung longbows (shortbows first where the longbow is not open yet); stringing them is faster XP for more clicks.

methods.name: Yew bows
methods.where: By a bank
methods.note: Cut yew logs into unstrung longbows (shortbows first where the longbow is not open yet); stringing them is faster XP for more clicks.

methods.name: Magic bows
methods.where: By a bank
methods.note: Cut magic logs into unstrung longbows (shortbows first where the longbow is not open yet); stringing them is faster XP for more clicks. Magic shortbows (80) lose a little; magic longbows (85) pay.

methods.name: The quests Jungle Potion, Recruitment Drive and The Dig Site
methods.where: Various places

methods.name: Brewing potions (Attack, Antipoison, Defence, Prayer, Super attack)
methods.where: By a bank
methods.note: The speed grows with the potion tier; so does the cost.

methods.name: High potions (Super restore, Saradomin brew, Super combat)
methods.where: By a bank
methods.note: Super restores from 63, Zamorak brews from 78, Saradomin brews from 81, Super combat potions from 90; the cheaper potion of a level band is often the better buy. Mastering Mixology (Children of the Sun) is the calm alternative from 60.

methods.name: Allotments
methods.where: The patches at Falador, Catherby, Ardougne, Port Phasmatys
methods.note: It grows in real time: you plant and come back.

methods.name: Tree and fruit tree runs
methods.where: Tree patches at Lumbridge, Varrock, Falador and Taverley; fruit trees at the Tree Gnome Stronghold, Catherby and Brimhaven
methods.note: Oaks from 15, willows from 30, apple trees from 27 and banana trees from 33; pay the gardener to protect them. A tree run every few hours is most of the Farming XP; herb runs add money.

methods.name: Tithe Farm
methods.where: Tithe Farm (Hosidius)
methods.note: The wiki's figures are for level 74+; at 34 it is noticeably slower.

methods.name: Bury banked bones
methods.where: At the Grand Exchange bank: buy or withdraw the bones and bury them by the bank
methods.note: Withdraw owned unnoted bones first. Buying bones is a separate paid method; it does not include collecting them through combat. Check the price and your budget before buying.

methods.name: Bury banked big bones
methods.where: At the Grand Exchange bank: buy or withdraw the big bones and bury them by the bank
methods.note: Withdraw owned unnoted bones first. Buying bones is a separate paid method; it does not include collecting them through combat. Check the price and your budget before buying.

methods.name: Scatter banked vile ashes
methods.where: At the Grand Exchange bank: buy or withdraw the vile ashes and scatter them by the bank
methods.note: Vile ashes give 25 Prayer XP; free players can scatter them, as fast as bones are buried (about 2,900 an hour, Wiki). Buying ashes is a paid method.

methods.name: Scatter banked fiendish ashes
methods.where: At the Grand Exchange bank: buy or withdraw the fiendish ashes and scatter them by the bank
methods.note: Fiendish ashes give 10 Prayer XP; free players can scatter them, as fast as bones are buried (about 2,900 an hour, Wiki). Buying ashes is a paid method.

methods.name: Gilded altar at a house party
methods.where: At the Rimmington house portal on world 330: offer bones at a host's gilded altar with both incense burners lit
methods.note: Buy noted bones, unnote them at Phials in the Rimmington General Store for 5 coins each, enter a house party host's house and use each bone on the gilded altar by hand. The altar gives 350% of the burying XP, and the wiki guide's pace is 2,550 bones an hour with banking, about 643,000 XP an hour with dragon bones.

methods.name: Libation bowl at the Teomat
methods.where: The Teomat in Varlamore: the exposed altar, Virilis and the libation bowl
methods.note: Un-note bones at Virilis (10 coins each), bless them at the exposed altar, break them into blessed bone shards with a chisel and offer the shards at the libation bowl filled with blessed sunfire wine (6 XP a shard). One jug serves 400 shards and takes 2 sunfire splinters. The Wiki's pace is 1,700 bones an hour; recharge Prayer at the Shrine of Ralos.

methods.name: Chaos altar in the Wilderness
methods.where: The Chaos Temple in level 38 Wilderness, a multi-combat area player killers visit: bring only what you can lose
methods.note: Offer bones at the Chaos altar by hand. It gives 350% of the burying XP like a gilded altar, and half the offerings are not used up, so each bone gives twice the XP of a gilded altar. The Elder Chaos druid outside the temple unnotes bones for 50 coins each. The wiki guide's pace is 2,000 offerings an hour using 1,000 bones. Player killers are the cost not counted here.

methods.name: Furnace smelting
methods.where: An accessible furnace near a bank
methods.note: The model chooses a usable recipe from your ores, coal, level and current prices. Ordinary iron smelting assumes 50% success; ring of forging and Blast Furnace effects are not modelled. Profit is not guaranteed.

methods.name: Turael's Slayer tasks
methods.where: Turael in Burthorpe gives the task; cows in the Lumbridge cow field are one of his tasks
methods.note: Slayer XP is the HP of each monster killed on task, a quarter of the melee XP. The rate uses cows; other tasks and the walk to Burthorpe for each task make it slower.

methods.name: Chaeldar's Slayer tasks
methods.where: Chaeldar in Zanaris gives the task; kill the assigned monsters in melee
methods.note: The rate is the Wiki's melee XP an hour for each task this master can give you, weighted by how often she gives it, and never above the damage your own melee deals an hour. Travel, food and potions are not counted.

methods.name: Konar's Slayer tasks
methods.where: Konar quo Maten on Mount Karuulm gives the task and the area to kill it in; kill the assigned monsters in melee
methods.note: The rate is the Wiki's melee XP an hour for each task this master can give you, weighted by how often she gives it, and never above the damage your own melee deals an hour. Travel, food and potions are not counted.

methods.name: Nieve's Slayer tasks
methods.where: Nieve in the Tree Gnome Stronghold gives the task; kill the assigned monsters in melee
methods.note: The rate is the Wiki's melee XP an hour for each task this master can give you, weighted by how often she gives it, and never above the damage your own melee deals an hour. Travel, food and potions are not counted.

methods.name: Duradel's Slayer tasks
methods.where: Duradel in Shilo Village gives the task; kill the assigned monsters in melee
methods.note: The rate is the Wiki's melee XP an hour for each task this master can give you, weighted by how often he gives it, and never above the damage your own melee deals an hour. Travel, food and potions are not counted.

methods.name: The Natural History Quiz
methods.where: Varrock Museum basement: speak to Orlando Smith
methods.note: Answering every display grants 1,000 Hunter and 1,000 Slayer XP once.

methods.name: Feldip weasels
methods.where: Feldip Hunter area (Feldip hills teleport)
methods.note: Follow the trail between the burrows and attack the bush at its end; a ring of pursuit reveals the whole track.

methods.name: Ruby harvests with copper longtails
methods.where: North of Falador or the Piscatoris Hunter area
methods.note: The Wiki rate is with two bird snares on copper longtails beside the butterflies; it moves on at 21 to red crabs, which need Construction 10 and Pandemonium.

methods.name: Sapphire glacialis
methods.where: Rellekka Hunter area (fairy ring DKS) or the Farming Guild
methods.note: The Wiki rate is at level 25 and rises with level; it moves on at 39 to embertailed jerboas, which need part of Eagles' Peak.

methods.name: Falconry: spotted kebbits
methods.where: Piscatoris falconry area (Piscatoris teleport, fairy ring AKQ or Kathy Corkat's boat)
methods.note: Rent a gyr falcon from Matthias for 500 coins; the weapon, shield and hands slots must be empty.

methods.name: Razor-backed kebbits
methods.where: Piscatoris Hunter area, east of fairy ring AKQ
methods.note: Track with a ring of pursuit; stamina potions lift the rate from 100,000 to 130,000. The Wiki moves on at 73 to black chinchompas (Wilderness, Eagles' Peak).

methods.name: Mahogany Homes: beginner contracts
methods.where: Amy in Falador gives the first contract; contracts are in Falador, Varrock, East Ardougne and Hosidius
methods.note: Needs a player-owned house (1,000 coins at an estate agent). Each hour uses about 375-575 planks and some steel bars; the Wiki rate is from the Mahogany Homes table.

methods.name: Mahogany Homes: novice contracts
methods.where: Amy in Falador gives the first contract; contracts are in Falador, Varrock, East Ardougne and Hosidius
methods.note: Needs a player-owned house (1,000 coins at an estate agent). Each hour uses about 450-545 oak planks and some steel bars; the Wiki rate is from the Mahogany Homes table.

methods.name: Mahogany Homes: adept contracts
methods.where: Amy in Falador gives the first contract; contracts are in Falador, Varrock, East Ardougne and Hosidius
methods.note: Needs a player-owned house (1,000 coins at an estate agent). Each hour uses about 475-520 teak planks and some steel bars; the Wiki rate is from the Mahogany Homes table.

methods.name: Mahogany Homes: expert contracts
methods.where: Amy in Falador gives the first contract; contracts are in Falador, Varrock, East Ardougne and Hosidius
methods.note: Needs a player-owned house (1,000 coins at an estate agent). Each hour uses about 475-555 mahogany planks and some steel bars; the Wiki rate is from the Mahogany Homes table.

methods.name: D'hide bodies (green to black)
methods.where: At the Grand Exchange bank: buy the tanned dragon leather and thread, then craft by the bank
methods.note: Each body uses 3 tanned dragon leather and thread. The model prices the leather and the body at the exchange. OSRS Wiki recipe pages, checked 2026-11-21.

methods.name: Battlestaves (water, earth, fire, air)
methods.where: At the Grand Exchange bank: buy battlestaves and the matching orbs, then attach them by the bank
methods.note: Each staff uses one battlestaff and one charged orb. The model prices both and the finished staff at the exchange. OSRS Wiki recipe pages, checked 2026-11-21.

methods.name: Glassblowing (orbs and lenses)
methods.where: At any bank with molten glass and a glassblowing pipe
methods.note: Each item uses one molten glass. OSRS Wiki recipe pages, checked 2026-11-21.

methods.name: Cannonballs
methods.where: The Edgeville furnace, with steel bars from the bank
methods.note: Needs Dwarf Cannon and an ammo mould. Each steel bar makes 4 cannonballs; slow but almost idle. OSRS Wiki recipe pages, checked 2026-11-21.

methods.name: Cooked karambwan
methods.where: A range or fire near a bank
methods.note: Needs Tai Bwo Wannai Trio to cook karambwan safely. OSRS Wiki recipe pages, checked 2026-11-21.

methods.name: Monkfish, sharks and anglerfish
methods.where: A range or fire near a bank
methods.note: Raw fish bought at the exchange; the model counts burnt fish at this level. OSRS Wiki recipe pages, checked 2026-11-21.
